request.training_policy: law-specific occupancy and gradient; independent roles; same-parent independent non-propagated references; sum shared occurrences; project every update
request.execution: uniform free-bit reset; hidden then output; all 500 operations; no discard
request.evaluation: finite at own K; equilibrium and frozen at all K plus oracle; PCG64 evaluation child reset per cell; one N-vector per operation
request.decision: inclusive thresholds without epsilon; all three seeds; nonmonotone budget brackets; both certified finite and certified(finite)<possible(equilibrium) for savings
request.cost_policy: all six finite fits; oracle sweeps null; draws/resets/pbits separate
request.diagnostics: M1 U-statistic and paired jackknife descriptive only; exact laws separate

validation_contract.joint_fixture: all 4096 ordered size-four batches from eight three-bit states
validation_contract.correlated_family: 1560 identical Bernoulli counts; no independence factorization
validation_contract.brackets: 729 ternary patterns; every compatible truth; all distinct bracket pairs

statistics.coverage_proof: Each CP marginal covers with probability >=1-0.05/1560. The union bound covers all 1560 intervals with probability >=0.95, without cross-cell independence. On that event the rectangle encloses the population loss. Coverage is conditional on frozen fits and binomial within-cell sampling. A finite grid is a numerical check, not a uniform proof.
